title: Mastery check: cost, access, and confidentiality of adult mental-health care
focus: cost, access, and confidentiality of adult mental-health care
essentialQuestion: How do I keep myself steady through a transition that removes most of my structure?
keyPoints: Adult mental-health care varies in cost, coverage, location, wait time, modality, and confidentiality; comparing access details is part of choosing a workable route.
Match the need to the appropriate service, ask how consent and confidentiality work in that setting, identify access constraints, and confirm the next step before sharing details.
